name: Exp_MACDCandle
summary: This EA trades based on the MACDCandle custom indicator, generating buy signals when the MACD histogram transitions to bullish (value 2) and sell signals when it transitions to bearish (value 0). It supports two operating modes: histogram crossover and signal line crossover, with configurable position sizing, stop loss, and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MACDCandle自定义指标进行交易，当MACD柱状图转为看涨（值为2）时产生买入信号，转为看跌（值为0）时产生卖出信号。支持直方图交叉和信号线交叉两种模式，具有可配置的仓位管理、止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于MACD指标的动量变化，通过自定义MACDCandle指标将MACD状态编码为离散数值（0、2等）来产生交易信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4的当前值从非2变为2时开多仓，从非0变为0时开空仓，这本质上捕捉了MACD动量方向的转变。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），同时也根据反向信号平仓——多头信号出现时平空仓，空头信号出现时平多仓。仓位管理采用两种模式：固定手数（LOT）或基于资金比例（MM参数默认0.1），通过TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现。资金管理方面，止损止盈比率为1:2，但缺少追踪止损和仓位动态调整机制，风险控制较为静态。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on MACD momentum changes, using a custom MACDCandle indicator that encodes MACD states into discrete values (0, 2, etc.) to generate trading signals. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when indicator buffer 4 transitions from non-2 to 2, and a sell signal when it transitions from non-0 to 0, essentially capturing shifts in MACD momentum direction. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), while also closing positions on reverse signals — closing sells on buy signals and closing buys on sell signals. Position sizing supports two modes: fixed lot size (LOT) or margin-based percentage (MM parameter defaults to 0.1), implemented through the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions. Money management features a 1:2 risk-reward ratio, but lacks trailing stops and dynamic position adjustment, making risk control relatively static and inflexible.

parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode (free margin/balance/net free margin/net balance/fixed lot)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于信号检测的K线索引

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: MACD信号模式（柱状图/信号线）

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于经典的MACD动量指标，理论基础扎实
提供止损止盈保护，风险回报比为1:2，有利于长期盈利期望
支持多空双向独立开关，交易灵活性高，可只做多或只做空
使用IsNewBar检查避免同一K线内重复交易，减少过度交易风险
代码结构清晰，模块化使用TradeAlgorithms库，易于维护
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on the classic MACD momentum indicator with solid theoretical foundation
Provides stop loss and take profit protection with a 1:2 risk-reward ratio, favorable for long-term expectancy
Independent on/off switches for buy and sell directions offer high trading flexibility
Uses IsNewBar check to prevent repeated trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Clean code structure with modular use of TradeAlgorithms library, easy to maintain
cons: 止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率（ATR），在不同品种和行情下适应性差
缺少追踪止损机制，大幅盈利行情可能因回撤而丢失大部分利润
依赖自定义指标MACDCandle，增加了部署复杂性和依赖风险
没有交易时间过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生不利信号
没有点差过滤和资金充足性检查，在高点差或保证金不足时可能导致异常
cons_en: Fixed stop loss and take profit in points without considering market volatility (ATR), poor adaptability across instruments and market conditions
Lacks trailing stop mechanism, potentially losing most profits during strong trending moves due to retracements
Depends on a custom MACDCandle indicator, increasing deployment complexity and dependency risk
No trading session filter, may generate unfavorable signals during low-liquidity periods
No spread filter or margin sufficiency check, which may cause anomalies during high spread or insufficient margin conditions
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈，使风险管理适应不同品种的波动特性
添加追踪止损功能，在趋势行情中锁定更多利润
增加交易时段过滤和点差过滤，避免不利市场条件下的交易
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to adapt risk management to different instruments' volatility characteristics
Add trailing stop functionality to lock in more profits during trending markets
Add trading session filter and spread filter to avoid trading under unfavorable market conditions

risk_points: 固定止损1000点在波动率剧烈变化时可能过大或过小，无法有效保护资金
缺少点差过滤，高点差环境下止损可能被扩大滑点触发
依赖外部自定义指标，若指标文件缺失将导致EA初始化失败
risk_points_en: Fixed 1000-point stop loss may be too large or too small during significant volatility changes, failing to effectively protect capital
No spread filter means high-spread environments could trigger stops with expanded slippage
Dependency on external custom indicator means missing indicator file will cause EA initialization failure
